site: Winton Woods Farm and Equestrian Center, 10073 Daly Road
Select nights Dec 3 to 23, 4 to 8 PM
about: Holidays on the Farm is a Great Parks of Hamilton County special event held at the Winton Woods Farm and Equestrian Center.
The park describes it as a way to step away from the holiday rush and discover a winter wonderland tradition in the heart of Winton Woods.
The event runs on 15 select nights: December 3 to 6, 10 to 13 and 17 to 23, each from 4 to 8 PM.
Activities include old-fashioned hayrides, pony rides, a farm animal meet and greet, photos with Santa and holiday crafts.
Great Parks Nature Education is on site as an exhibitor, and food and drink come from HighGrain Holly Jolly Inn, The Loaded Goat and Queen City Snowie, which sells shaved ice and hot chocolate.
Single night tickets are $12 for adults and $10 for kids 3 to 12 and seniors 65 and older online, and $15 and $13 on site. Kids 2 and under are free.
Season passes cost $20 for adults and $15 for kids 3 to 12 and seniors, and each pass is valid for one entry per person per night.
Pony riders must be at least two years old, no taller than 48 inches and no heavier than 85 pounds.
Food, drinks and merchandise cost extra, Motor Vehicle Permit requirements are waived during event hours, and pets are not permitted at the farm.
